title: Seamless Access to IMF World Economic Outlook (WEO) Data
text: imfweo R package access analyze International Monetary Fund’s World Economic Outlook (WEO) publications. WEO provides comprehensive analysis forecasts global economy published twice year - typically April October. package designed work seamlessly World Bank’s International Debt Statistics (IDS) World Development Indicators (WDI) provided wbids wbwdi package, respectively. follows principles EconDataverse. package product Teal Insights sponsored affiliated IMF way, except use WEO data. 💡 package currently use IMF Data API several reasons: () API’s SDMX format complex difficult parse; (ii) leveraging rsdmx package require releasing imfweo GPL license; (iii) ’s unclear whether API provides access historical WEO publications.

title: imfweo: Seamless Access to IMF World Economic Outlook (WEO) Data — imfweo-package
text: Provides tools download, process, analyze data International Monetary Fund's World Economic Outlook (WEO) https://www.imf.org/en/publications/weo. Functions support downloading complete WEO releases, accessing specific economic indicators selected countries, listing available data.

what: List Available IMF WEO Publications — weo_list_publications
title: List Available IMF WEO Publications — weo_list_publications
text: Returns data frame WEO publications package knows download. IMF releases WEO database twice per year: Spring (April) Fall (October) list maintained lookup table inside package rather detected online, releases published IMF Data portal (October 2025 onwards) sit behind opaque per-vintage identifiers. new release therefore becomes available package update.

title: imfweo 0.2.0
text: Removed weo_get_latest_publication(). move WEO database IMF Data portal, vintage sits behind opaque per-vintage identifier, latest publication can longer detected IMF website. known releases now kept lookup table inside package, whose newest entry default publication weo_get(), weo_get_entities() weo_get_series(). New releases become available package update — see maintainer note top R/weo_releases.R add one. Removed check_latest argument weo_list_publications(), relied online check. function now returns known releases lookup table longer depends current date. end_year now defaults year recent known publication.

title: imfweo 0.2.0
text: Added support 2025 Fall 2026 Spring publications, distributed single multi-sheet Excel workbook IMF Data portal instead two tab-delimited files used 2025 Spring. Country group codes releases mapped back pre-portal codes (e.g. G001 001) using crosswalk shipped workbook, entity IDs stay comparable across publications.

title: imfweo 0.2.0
text: Fixed download 2021 2023 publications. IMF retired .ashx URLs vintages served ; files still available .xls. download answers error page HTTP 200 status now reported failed download instead parsed data. Add support publications 2025 Spring weo_get().
